label: Grandstream GWN7802P
description: Grandstream GWN7802P - 20-port Layer 2+ managed PoE switch: 16x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 (16 PoE+) and 4x 1G SFP uplinks, 802.3af/at, 30 W a port, 240 W total PoE budget from a 270 W supply. 40 Gbps switching capacity, 29.76 Mpps, single-fan 1U 440 mm case.

poe.note: Datasheet Max Total PoE Output Power 240 W from a 270 W integrated supply, Max Output Power per PoE Port 30 W, standards IEEE 802.3af/at. 240 W is the ceiling, not 16 ports x 30 W.

fabric.note: Datasheet Switching Capability 40 Gbps, Total non-blocking throughput 20 Gbps, forwarding rate 29.76 Mpps.

notes: Datasheet: 16 PoE ports at 802.3af/at, 4x 1G SFP, 1 console, 270 W supply, 240 W PoE budget, 3.0 kg. The technical-specification page lists 1 fan for the GWN7802P and none for the GWN7802. Console 115200 8-N-1 into the CLI.
